carried_by: named sparse morph targets and source-rate facial curves and local bone samples; admitted by face_valid
header: 17 u32: magic, version 1, file bytes, targets (1 to 256), vertices, deltas, clips (1 to 64), bones, curves, joints, then the byte offsets of the target table (80), the rig names, the bone table, the curve table, the clip table, the delta table and the data; 12 zero bytes
rows: a target 80 bytes, a rig name 64, a bone 68, a curve 68, a clip 80, a delta 32; the tables stand in that order with no gaps
rules: the file's size is the size it states, at most 41943040 bytes
each table starts where the one before ends
a name is printable bytes then zeros, and no two rig names are the same
every float is finite; a clip has 2 to 2000 frames at a rate above 0 and at most 240

fixture.source: one target "blink" of one delta, one bone and one curve on the joint "face", one clip of two frames at 24 a second (format-profile.coax fp_efc1)
